title: Medications
desc: The main (systemic) medication with a calendar and dose history; below it, supportive medications, each with its own daily mark, dosing instructions and reminder.
stopConfirm: Discontinue {name}? The dose history is kept and reminders will stop.

empty.title: Add the first medication
empty.desc: Enter the dose and when to take it. We'll send dose reminders and count the days, so you don't have to keep it all in your head.

hero.notDue: No dose due today ({schedule}). You can still mark one taken off schedule.
hero.notDueNext: No dose due today ({schedule}). Next: {date}. You can still mark one taken off schedule.

streak.title: Last 4 weeks
streak.dosesInRow: {n, plural, one {{n} dose in a row} other {{n} doses in a row}}
streak.daysInRow: {n, plural, one {{n} day in a row} other {{n} days in a row}}

dose.current: Current dose: {dose}. The new dose takes effect on the date you enter; the old one stays in the history.
dose.reasonPlaceholder: e.g., blood pressure and hand-foot syndrome

medForm.title: Medication
medForm.name: Name
medForm.noDaysHint: If no days are selected, it uses the weekday of the start date.
medForm.interval: Every N days, counted from the start date
medForm.instructionsPlaceholder: in the morning on an empty stomach, 30 minutes before breakfast; recheck TSH and free T4 in 8 weeks
medForm.note: There is one daily mark per medication, even with several doses a day. The main medication sends reminders on the schedule from Settings, supportive medications at the time you set.

journal.title: Log
journal.empty: No entries yet. Click “Taken today” and the first one will appear here.

calendar.title: Dose calendar
calendar.rangeCleared: {from} – {to}: marks cleared, {days, plural, one {{days} day} other {{days} days}}
calendar.pauseHint: Paused means days when a doctor has stopped the medication: they don't count as skipped and aren't included in the adherence percentage.
